# Instagram Posts Scraper

> An Apify actor that returns every post of a list of Instagram accounts with full captions, likes, comments, video views, media URLs, tagged users, collaborators and paid-partnership flags, without an Instagram login.

## Docs

- [Apify Store page](https://apify.com/goat255/instagram-posts-scraper): run it, prices, input form
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): input and output fields, MCP and HTTP setup for AI agents
- [README.md](README.md): overview, use cases and a demo video

## Quick call

- POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/goat255~instagram-posts-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN with body {"usernames": ["example_user"], "maxPostsPerUser": 24}

- [All our actors](https://apify.com/goat255)
